src:
MOV     SI, OFFSET TXT1
CLD
NEXT1:
LODSB                    ; AL = next character
OR      AL, AL           ; 0 ends the text
JZ      DONE1
MOV     AH, 09h          ; colour the cell at the cursor
MOV     BX, 000Bh        ; page 0, light cyan on black
MOV     CX, 1
INT     10h
MOV     AL, [SI-1]       ; the character again: AL may not survive
MOV     AH, 0Eh          ; teletype: write it and move on
INT     10h
JMP     NEXT1
DONE1:
MOV     BH, 0            ; page 0
MOV     AX, 0E0Dh        ; BIOS teletype: CR...
INT     10h
MOV     AX, 0E0Ah        ; ...and LF: on to the next line
INT     10h
MOV     AH, 09h
MOV     DX, OFFSET MSG1
INT     21h

TXT1    DB      "Light cyan, one character at a time", 0
MSG1    DB      "^ coloured with 09h, moved on with 0Eh", 13, 10, "$"
